blk_part_02_two_family_names.text: Most people in Spain have one first name and two family names. The first family name usually comes from the father. The second family name comes from the mother. So one name shows both sides of the family. The famous painter Pablo Picasso shows this. His two family names were Ruiz and Picasso. Ruiz was his father's family name, and Picasso was his mother's. Later, he used only his mother's name.

blk_part_03_las_fallas_a_festival_of_fir.text: On the night of 19 March, people burn almost all of them. This fire night is called la Cremà. Why burn something so beautiful? The idea comes from carpenters, people who make things from wood. In winter, they used old wood to hold candles, so they could work at night. At the end of winter, the days got longer, so they burned the old wood. They did it on 19 March, the day of Saint Joseph. Saint Joseph also worked with wood, so he was special to them. Every year, visitors vote for their favourite ninot. The winners are saved from the fire and go to a museum.

Pilgrims are people who travel to a special church or place. The most popular way starts in France and is about 800 kilometres long.
